xref.title: Leon Wilkeson's Death (2001)
xref.body: Bass player Leon Wilkeson, a crash survivor who participated in the reunion, developed chronic liver and lung disease. He died in his sleep at a Florida beach resort on July 27, 2001. "Leon Wilkerson developed chronic liver and lung disease. He died in his sleep at a Florida beach resort on July 27, 2001."

xref.title: 2008 Plane Crash and Tattoo Impact
xref.body: In 2008, Travis Barker was a survivor of a severe plane crash, which resulted in third-degree burns across his body. The subsequent skin graft procedures led to the loss of a significant portion of his existing tattoos, requiring new ink to be applied to the healed skin. "Travis, he's the survivor of a terrible plane crash back in 2008 that left him with third-degree burns all over his body. That's, and the subsequent skin grafts wiped out a lot of his ink. So once he healed, the new skin got new ink."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Travis Barker's Plane Crash Survival (2008)
xref.body: In 2008, blink-182 drummer Travis Barker was the sole survivor of a horrific private jet crash in Columbia, South Carolina. The accident resulted in the death of his friend, DJ AM. "Blink wanted to drummer Travis Barker was the only survivor of a horrendous private jet crash in Columbia, South Carolina in 2008, an accident that killed his friend DJ AM."

xref.title: Mike Peters Death (2025) – Cancer Activist and Everest Base Camp Concert
xref.body: Mike Peters, energetic frontman of Welsh band The Alarm, died in 2025. A multiple cancer survivor, he founded the Love Hope Strength Foundation for cancer research and patient support. In 2007 he led an expedition to Everest Base Camp for the highest-altitude concert ever performed on land, raising cancer research funds. "In 2007, he led an expedition to Everest Base Camp for the concert at the highest altitude ever performed on land."

xref.title: Advocacy for Sexual Abuse Victims
xref.body: Tori Amos is a survivor of sexual assault, having been raped at knifepoint at age 22. She has been a part of the Rape, Abuse & Incest National Network (RAINN) and continues to support this organization and similar ones that help victims. "This isn't especially important because Tori, because she was raped at knife point when she was 22. She continues to support that organization and others like it."

xref.body: Keyboardist Billy Powell, a crash survivor, joined a Christian rock band called Vision after the initial hiatus following the crash. He later participated in the Leonard Skinnerd reunion. "Billy Powell joined a Christian rock band called Vision."

xref.title: Brian Potvin's Talent Scouting and Songwriting
xref.body: Upon the Pikes' retirement, guitarist Brian Potvin transitioned into talent scouting for Polygram and Universal Records, working with artists such as Finger Eleven and Tegan and Sara. He also freelances as a songwriter, contributing material to other bands and to the Discovery Channel, including the series "Survivor Man." "When the Pikes retired, he went to work scouting talent for Polygram, and later Universal Records. This had him work with everyone from finger 11 to Tegan and Sarah. He also freelances as a songwriter. Some material goes to other bands, while other stuff has been for the Discovery Channel, including the series Survivor Man."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Columbine Survivor and "Adam's Song"
xref.body: Greg Barnes was a student who survived the Columbine rampage but lost friends. He later took his own life, leaving Blink-182's "Adam's Song" on repeat on his stereo in the garage where he hanged himself. "Greg Barnes was a student at Columbine that survived the rampage, but some of his friends did not. And when Greg decided to take his own life, he left that song and repeat on his stereo in the garage where he hanged himself."

xref.title: Early Career Success
xref.body: Matthew Good began his fruitful multi-decade career in the very late 1980s or early 1990s, establishing himself as one of the prominent "stars" during Canada's 1990s music boom. He is noted as a long-term survivor in the music business, indicating sustained relevance and activity over several decades. "Our lady piece, Matthew Good...had fruitful multi-decade careers that began in either the very late 1980s or the early 1990s."

xref.title: Polio Survivor
xref.body: Ian Dury of the British band The Blockheads lived for many years with the lasting effects of polio, a disease he contracted as a child after being exposed to it in a public swimming pool. "It ranges from Ian jury of the British band The Blockheads, who lived for many years with the results of polio, something he caught as a kid in a public pool."

xref.title: Tommy Ramone's Family Background
xref.body: Tommy Ramone, whose real name was Tamis Urdelje, was the Jewish son of a Holocaust survivor from Hungary. "His real name was Tamis Urdelje, the Jewish son of a Holocaust survivor from Hungary."
